rules.message: Review permission check result and caller identity before privileged action

metadata.hypothesis: Could a denied result be ignored, or a caller identity be confused? Trace callers and all branches.
metadata.recommendation: Enforce permission before side effects; reject denied callers and document identity boundaries.

rules.message: Review explicitly exported component and its permission boundary

metadata.hypothesis: Can an untrusted caller reach a privileged operation through this exported interface?
metadata.recommendation: Disable unnecessary exports; otherwise require an appropriate permission and validate callers and input.

rules.message: Review object deserialization trust boundary and class restrictions

metadata.hypothesis: Can untrusted serialized input instantiate unexpected classes or trigger side effects?
metadata.recommendation: Prefer typed structured data; constrain classes, sizes and sources; reject malformed input.

rules.message: Review input conversion or memory-copy bounds

metadata.hypothesis: Can an untrusted length, offset or value exceed the accepted domain before this operation?
metadata.recommendation: Validate ranges and lengths before use, check arithmetic overflow, and fail closed.

rules.message: Review logging of potentially sensitive variables

metadata.hypothesis: Does a reachable log statement expose a real secret to a less privileged reader?
metadata.recommendation: Remove secret values from logs; retain minimal event metadata and redact at the source.
